status: PROPOSED by the C6 harness worker on 2026-11-18 (re-proposed after review of PR #3414); C6 and Root set the final values
basis: Every ratio is p50 over p50, and --check requires at least 30 samples on each side (otherwise INSUFFICIENT, which fails). Maxima are DATA-ENGINE-REVIEW.md section 5 targets where it gives one; otherwise about 1.25x the cost that would grow linearly with the axis, the linear reference taken from the event counts at sample time. Ratios only: never heap, state size or milliseconds (AGENTS.md invariant 6). The P1/P3/P5 targets fail on HEAD by design until those fixes land.

notGated.phase-advance-10000-over-500 / phase-adv: reported only: the pooled phase-advance row mixes five different transitions and gets 5 samples per turn; repeating one advance 30 times costs 2.7-8 s per sample at 10,000 events (about 4 minutes), and P1 is gated by append, move-commit and weapon-attack instead
notGated.sim-12v12-over-4v4: reported only: one runner game is a 20-turn macro sample of 1-3 s; 30 of them would cost about 1.5 minutes for the 12v12 side alone

append-10000-over-500.why: section 5: append at 10,000 events within 1.5x append at 500 (P1)

append-2000-over-500.why: quick-mode form of the P1 target

move-commit-10000-over-500.why: a move appends events, so P1 sets its shape (move-commit-repeat rows)

weapon-attack-10000-over-500.why: P1 plus the whole-log scans of P8 (weapon-attack-repeat rows)

reachable-walk8-over-walk4-clear.why: hexes within 8 over within 4 is 217/61 = 3.56, plus about 25% (P3)

reachable-walk8-over-walk4-wooded.why: same area bound in heavy woods (P3)

path-30-over-5-clear.why: 2x linear in path length on an open map (P4)

replay-load-10000-over-2000.why: section 5: linear in events (10,003/2,047 = 4.89 at the checkpoints), plus about 25%

replay-load-2000-over-500.why: quick-mode form: linear in events (2,047/697 = 2.94 at the checkpoints), plus about 25%

los-projection-48x51-over-16x17.why: linear in map hexes (2437/271 = 8.99), plus about 25% (P5)

bot-decision-48x51-over-16x17.why: a decision should depend on movement points, not map size (P6)

bot-decision-48u-over-4u.why: more units add occupancy and targets, not a new search per hex (P6)
